description: This file defines a React functional component 'MakeMCPPublicForm' used for selecting MCP servers and making them public via a multi-step UI. It includes state management, effects to initialize selections, UI rendering, and API call handling.

methods.name: handleClose
methods.description: Resets form and state, then calls the onClose callback.

methods.name: handleNext
methods.description: Advances to the next step if at least one server is selected.

methods.name: handlePrevious
methods.description: Goes back to the previous step.

methods.name: handleServerSelection
methods.description: Updates the set of selected servers based on checkbox toggle.

methods.name: handleSelectAll
methods.description: Selects or deselects all servers based on checkbox.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Calls API to make selected MCP servers public, handles success and errors.

methods.name: renderStep1Content
methods.description: Renders the UI for selecting MCP servers, including search and selection logic.

methods.name: renderStep2Content
methods.description: Renders the confirmation screen listing servers to be made public.

methods.name: renderStepContent
methods.description: Chooses which step content to display based on current step.

methods.name: renderStepButtons
methods.description: Renders navigation buttons for the multi-step process.
